title: Frequency Band Policy
description: Versioned thresholds that classify a query's monthly search volume into HF/MF/LF bands. Boundaries are data, never hardcoded numbers in code. Changing a boundary requires a new revision; the previous revision is never edited in place.

supersedes_revision.description: Revision this document replaces, or null for the first revision.

digest.description: sha256 hex digest of the canonical (sorted-key, compact) JSON form of this document with the digest field itself removed.

region.description: Region code the volume measurements this policy classifies were taken in, e.g. Topvisor region '213' for Moscow.

freshness_max_age_days.description: A volume measurement older than this is treated as stale and classifies as UNKNOWN, never as its last known band.

bands.description: Exactly one contiguous, non-overlapping definition of LF, MF and HF starting at 0 and ending open-ended.

max_monthly_volume.description: Exclusive upper bound. null marks the open-ended top band (HF).
